description: Scrape Owler.com for public company intelligence — CEO, revenue, employee ranges, industry, headquarters, funding, news, and competitors.

companyUrls.description: List of Owler company URLs (e.g. `https://www.owler.com/company/apple`), plain domains (e.g. `apple.com`, `stripe.com`), or Owler slugs (e.g. `openai`).
companyUrls.title: Company URLs or domains (mode=byCompany)

industry.description: Keep only companies whose Owler industry or sub-industry matches this sector. Applied after each profile is fetched; combine with Search or By Company.
industry.title: Industry filter

location.description: Optional text that must appear in the company's headquarters or city, e.g. `California`, `London`, or `Ontario`. Case-insensitive; leave empty for all locations.
location.title: Headquarters location filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total company profiles emitted. Search mode paginates through Owler's competitor graph until this cap is reached (up to 200).
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape. `search` uses Owler's public company search to find companies by name or keyword, then expands through their competitor graph. `byCompany` fetches specific profiles from Owler URLs or website domains.
enumTitles: Search — find companies by name or keyword
By Company — full profile for specific companies (URL or domain)
mode.title: Mode

ownershipStatus.description: Keep only Public companies, Private companies, or Government agencies. Applied after each profile is fetched.
ownershipStatus.title: Ownership filter

searchQuery.description: Company name, domain, or keyword to search for, e.g. `stripe`, `artificial intelligence`, or `renewable energy`. Owler returns its relevance-ranked company matches; the actor fetches their profiles and continues through their competitor graphs until Max items is reached.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

title: Owler Scraper Input
